view.name: Mission summary with score
view.description: Immersive-mode end-of-session summary with a three-tier star score (Tiro/Proficiens/Peritus), feedback card, fork-on-GitHub panel and Back to Mission List button.

regions.label: Top-right utility bar: dashed-border 'Source' GitHub link and round theme toggle
'Mission Accomplished!' heading with three-tier star level (Tiro / Proficiens / Peritus, Peritus earned) and caption '(No help, fluid)'
White elevated Feedback card with bulleted coaching notes
Dashed-outline 'Build Your Own Version' promo with 'Fork on GitHub' button
Full-width olive 'BACK TO MISSION LIST' button

evidence.note: White rounded 24px card with shadow, title + divider + bullet list
Exception: outlined dashed-border variant with one primary action 'Fork on GitHub'
Stars show an awarded proficiency tier, not an input for rating
Only Source link and theme toggle; no global navigation

structure.layout: single centered narrow column (472px) results screen with minimal top-right header (Source link, theme toggle)

aesthetics.typography: Libre Baskerville (serif, bold) for headings, tier labels and card titles; Nunito (rounded sans) for body, buttons (800 weight, uppercase on main CTA) and captions (italic)
aesthetics.typeScale: Restrained: h2 24px/700 serif, h3 19px serif, tier labels ~18px, body 16px Nunito, captions 14-16px italic; CTA 20px/800 uppercase letterspaced

notes: Warm parchment (#f5f2eb) background with olive green (#5c6b48) accent; distinctive dashed 2px olive borders on GitHub buttons and a 1px dashed outline on the 'Build your own' box contrast with the solid shadowed feedback card. Tier names are Latin (Tiro, Proficiens, Peritus) with 1/2/3 filled stars; unearned tiers grey, earned tier black stars + olive serif label. Feedback bullets are AI-generated coaching (no explicit AI marker). Theme toggle (💻 system/🌙 dark) switches to a dark navy theme with peach headings (verified live). Proposed new entry 'completion-summary' for this results-screen pattern.
